## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The legacy fetcher should honor the existing three-attempt cap when the inventory service is unreachable.

## Changes

The pull request adds a legacy inventory fetcher and a health probe, with tests for immediate success, success on the final attempt, HTTP errors, and retry exhaustion. It also proposes exempting legacy modules from the retry cap.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- app/legacy/fetch.py:7 — correctness — Cap legacy inventory fetches at three attempts — When every connection attempt to the legacy inventory service times out, `fetch_inventory` tries eight times. The existing rule in `docs/review-rules.md:5` says “Code that retries a network call must stop after at most 3 attempts.” — During an outage, five extra ten-second timeouts and retry delays can occupy the calling worker for another 55 seconds.
